## Flagship Open-Source Security Tools

- [ReconMaster](https://github.com/VIPHACKER100/ReconMaster): Automated multi-tool reconnaissance framework for subdomain discovery, DNS validation, and asset mapping.
- [VIPSQLi](https://github.com/VIPHACKER100/VIPSQLi): Safe and rapid SQL injection triage engine identifying vulnerabilities in under 30 seconds.
- [DarkWin-AATK](https://github.com/VIPHACKER100/DarkWin-AATK): Advanced automation toolkit for ethical hackers and penetration testers.
- [LLM-COUNCIL](https://github.com/VIPHACKER100/LLM-COUNCIL): Multi-agent deliberative AI council for non-hedging security risk assessment.
- [PhishShield-Engine](https://github.com/VIPHACKER100/PhishShield-Engine): Machine learning platform detecting phishing, lookalike domains, and email spoofs.
- [DarkWin-NGASR](https://github.com/VIPHACKER100/DarkWin-NGASR): Modular security research and automation engine with 500+ scan modules.
